notes: Join table: one row per (site_id, year) for every FLUXMET annual site-year (6336 rows), with igbp/data_hub, both NEE values and their own QC/random/ustar_term/joint terms, VUT_minus_CUT (gC m-2 yr-1, computed whenever both raw values are present regardless of QC), qualifies_VUT/qualifies_CUT (paper rule, QC_THRESHOLD_YY=0.5, each gated on its own QC column), category (both/VUT_only/CUT_only/neither), and neither_reason (no_value vs fails_qc, only populated when category == 'neither').
